newsitem.title: PERU: More hostages to be released - TV report.
newsitem.headline: More hostages to be released - TV report.

text.p: Marxist rebels holding around 400 hostages in the Japanese embassy in Peru have signalled they will soon release more captives, Peruvian television said on Friday.

Quoting one of their journalists talking by phone with a rebel inside the embassy, Channel 4 television said the guerrillas had signalled they would let more captives go. It did not say when or how many.
Moments after the television report, a sign was held up at a second floor side window of the besieged Japanese embassy residence.
Written in Japanese, the sign read "OK to leave again" and underneath in smaller characters "All Hostages".
The exact meaning of the sign was not immediately clear. Channel Four television interpreted it as supporting the unidentified rebel's telephone comment that more captives would be freed soon.
